title: Commiphora molmol essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Commiphora molmol essential oil is a volatile oil derived from the resin of the Myrobalan tree, native to regions of India and Africa. It is known for its strong, balsamic aroma and has been used in traditional herbal medicine for centuries. This essential oil is valued for its potential anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and analgesic properties. In herbalism, it is often used to support digestive health and to alleviate symptoms of respiratory conditions. It may also be applied topically to reduce skin irritations and promote healing.
